### Testing a function

Writing a code I should run every time for a different species

```{r}
penguins

penguins |> 
  filter(species == species) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = body_mass, y = bill_len)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
  labs(x = "Body mass g", y = "Bill length mm", title = "Gentoo")
```

Building a function, which run the same plot for different species

```{r}
filter_spp = function(data, species) {
  data |> 
  filter(species == {{species}}) |>  # double bracket because the name of the column is the same as the argument of the function
    ggplot(aes(x = body_mass, y = bill_len)) +
    geom_point() +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm") +
    labs(x = "Body mass g", y = "Bill length mm", title = "Gentoo")
}

p <- filter_spp(penguins, "Adelie")
p
```

```{r}
buggy <- function(x){

g <- function(x)buggy(x)
buggy(1)
```
